why.title: Product thinking. Insurance depth. Engineering reality.

items.description: Not a generic CRM, workflow tool or development practice adapted to insurance. Iorta organizes technology around the work insurers, intermediaries, underwriters, service teams and claims teams actually perform.
Use a focused Verse product where it fits. Extend, integrate or modernize around it where enterprise reality requires more.
Create new experiences, APIs, workflows and data access around established platforms instead of assuming transformation begins with full replacement.
Work across legacy and modern systems, different integration patterns and different levels of digital maturity.
Bancassurance, Takaful, advisor-led distribution, localization and multi-market operating requirements are part of the design conversation, not afterthoughts.
Turnaround. Adoption. Productivity. Operational visibility. Change speed. The value is in what the business can do differently.

operatingModel.eyebrow: The insurance operating model is changing
operatingModel.title: More channels. Faster decisions. Less room for friction.
operatingModel.lede: Insurance transformation is moving beyond another portal or isolated application. Customers move between digital and assisted channels. Advisors need useful information while they work. Brokers need greater operational control. Banks and partners need easier ways to distribute protection. Underwriters and claims specialists need better information and less repetitive work. Technology leaders need to modernize without destabilizing business-critical systems.

changing.description: Support direct, advisor, broker, bank and partner channels.
Turn submissions into more structured decision workflows.
Put relevant information where decisions happen.
Move from basic access to proactive service.
Create clearer claims journeys from notification to settlement.

improve.description: Automate predictable activities and repeated hand-offs.
Remove avoidable waits between teams, systems and approvals.
Put urgent, valuable or exceptional work at the top of the queue.
See where work is waiting, ageing or becoming a bottleneck.
Apply structured rules and repeatable workflows.
Keep expertise focused on decisions that require judgement.

distribution-modernization.title: Distribution Modernization
distribution-modernization.lede: Modernize every way insurance reaches the customer.
distribution-modernization.body: Connect direct, agency, brokerage, banking and partner-led distribution with clearer digital processes and better business visibility.

underwriting-modernization.title: Underwriting Modernization
underwriting-modernization.body: Bring document understanding, submission completeness, rules, decision-ready information, referrals and human review into a more structured underwriting model.

core-modernization.title: Core Modernization
core-modernization.lede: Keep the core. Change what's possible.
core-modernization.body: Modernize experiences, APIs, workflows, data access and applications progressively around the systems that still create business value.

digital-insurance-takaful.title: Digital Insurance & Takaful
digital-insurance-takaful.lede: Build digital propositions around modern technology from day one.
digital-insurance-takaful.body: Support digital acquisition, distribution, onboarding, servicing, claims and operational journeys with configurable foundations.

intelligentOps.title: Automate the routine. Surface what needs judgement.
intelligentOps.lede: Modern insurance technology should do more than store information. It should help teams interpret what has arrived, identify what requires attention and move straightforward work forward while preserving specialist control.

steps.description: Surface urgent, high-value or exceptional work.
Guide users toward relevant next actions.
Move complex or unusual cases to specialists.

techFoundation.title: Add new journeys without rebuilding everything underneath.
techFoundation.lede: Modern insurance experiences increasingly depend on secure connectivity, identity, permission, governance and resilient operations.

regionalReality.title: Adapt without rebuilding market by market.
regionalReality.lede: Insurance varies across regulation, language, product structure, distribution models and technology maturity. Iorta TechNXT is designed around configurable foundations that can support different operating environments.

items.description: Products, approvals and workflows that can vary by market.
Agency, broker, bancassurance, direct and partner-led structures.
